text:
raj (idp): heads up — after the RBAC role rename that went out ~0200 UTC, we've started seeing SCIM provisioning failures for a handful of SSO customers. 401 / signature mismatch logs.

maria (sec-eng): ugh. which customers? any PII impacted? :eyes:

raj (idp): a few enterprise tenants (okta + azure). provisioning attempts failing during user create/patch.

sam (infra): can you paste the error blob? quick look at logs might show KMS or assertion issue.

raj (idp): pasting a sanitized snippet below:

```
INF 2024-05-01T02:07:12Z scim:request tenant=acme-op status=401 err="invalid_signature"
DBG raw_saml_assertion="<Assertion xmlns=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:assertion\">...<Subject><NameID Format=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress\">user@example.com</NameID>...</Subject>...<Signature ...>...</Signature></Assertion>"
ERR 2024-05-01T02:07:12Z kms:decrypt tenant=acme-op key_alias=alias/redwood-idp key_err="NotFound" ctx_id=0x7f2
```

julia (sre): kms NotFound explains the signature verification failing if we can't decrypt the key. Did we rotate the idp key alias yesterday? @deploy-bot any deploys touching KMS aliases?

deploy-bot: Deploy 2024-05-01T01:58 by @sam (infra) — released infra/roles/v2 and idp/key-rotation helper scripts.

maria (sec-eng): ok that lines up. But why would an RBAC role rename change the KMS alias lookup? sounds like a config key path changed.

raj (idp): when we rolled roles/v2 we also migrated tenant config keys from `tenant.config.roles` -> `tenant.config.access.roles`. the idp service still reads the old path for key aliases in some legacy tenants, so it ends up querying a missing alias name.

sam (infra): that migration script missed a fallback mapping. my bad — I scoped it to service config but not idp-legacy readers. quick mitigation: add a read-fallback for `tenant.config.roles.key_alias` -> `tenant.config.access.roles.key_alias`.

maria (sec-eng): also: audit logs show signature algorithm change for some assertions. we had a vuln triage ticket about RSASSA-PSS fallback earlier; are we now generating assertions with a different alg that clients reject?

raj (idp): yep — some tenants are still on `rsa-sha1` legacy and our new signing helper defaults to `rsassa-pss-sha256` when the key is RSA-PSS enabled. Okta rejects the assertion signature in a couple of older integrations.

julia (sre): big picture action items:
- hotfix config fallback (sam)
- add temporary toggle to force `rsa-sha256` for affected tenants (raj)
- patch audit logs to include key_alias + alg in the last 72h window (maria)
- notify affected customers and open incident channel (me)

sam (infra): I'll push a config fallback within 15m and roll a canary to two non-prod tenants.

raj (idp): I can add the signing alg toggle behind a feature flag; will need a short deploy.

maria (sec-eng): for vuln triage: we need to record whether RSA-PSS was used *without* proper client validation — that could be a compatibility/perf thing, not a vuln, but document it. I'll start a short blameless note and tag security advisory if we see token forgery risk.

raj (idp): quick test result after initial fallback patch (canary):
```
PASS tenant=canary-1 scim:create status=201 user_id=U12345
PASS tenant=canary-2 scim:patch status=204
```

julia (sre): good. roll to prod after one hour of green + smoke tests.

maria (sec-eng): also add an audit event for RBAC migration actions. we need an immutable record: who renamed the role, when, and affected tenant list. right now that info is in the deploy PR only.

sam (infra): will wire a migration-audit event to kinesis with schema: `migration_id`, `actor`, `changed_paths`, `timestamp`, `affected_tenants`.

raj (idp): FYI: while doing manual repro I noticed duplicate-user errors from SCIM when NameID format changed post-role-rename. Some tenants have NameID mapping keyed off `role:admin` which we renamed — so SCIM attempted create and then detected existing user with different sub formats. I patched a tolerant dedupe check for 24h.

maria (sec-eng): keep that tolerant window short and log the dedupe rationale for post-incident review. don't leave it forever.

julia (sre): incident updates:
- severity: P2
- customer impact: ~6 tenants with intermittent provisioning failures
- mitigation done: config fallback + signing toggle canary
- next update: +60m or on regression

raj (idp): I'll open a follow-up to reconcile tenant config keys (long term), and a PR to backfill audit events for the last 7 days.

sam (infra): hotfix merged and deployed to prod canary at 1743502000, rolling to remaining nodes now.

deploy-bot: Release 1743502450 by @sam (infra) — infra/roles/fallback applied to idp-service

maria (sec-eng): thanks all. after full roll I'll run the vuln triage checklist and decide if we need to escalate to advisory.

julia (sre): closing temp incident thread here. open new follow-ups for: config reconciliation, audit backfill, signing alg compatibility matrix.

raj (idp): noted. will post PR links in eng-security afterwards.
